notes: PLAN.md tier 9 section 9.3, class EX: no Python counterpart, and a faithful C++ reimplementation of Stripenn 1.1.65.22's own detection method (project owner directive, see cpp/tools/stripes_impl.hpp). This tiny committed fixture is a mechanics sanity check (argument parsing, cool loading, exit status, no crash), not a statistical validation; the recall and precision gate of PLAN.md 9.3 is measured on real GM12878 data by cpp/scripts/stripe_calibration.py, which is far too large to commit (cpp/AGENTS_CONTRACT.md rule 10). --pValue 1.0 --fdr 1.0 keeps every geometric candidate here since this fixture's chromosomes are too short and sparse to build a meaningful background sample.

As the cool case above, but through the h5 whole-matrix loader (no per-chromosome band reader for h5, cpp/tools/hicDetectStripes.cpp mirrors hicDetectLoops' approach: hicx::read_hicexplorer_h5 then hicx::select_bins).
An unknown --chromosomes name exits 1 before anything is written, the same behaviour hicDetectLoops.cpp has for the same condition.
